FTD_TITLES.k1: G1000 型 PFD の読み方
FTD_TITLES.k2: PFD の読み取り（10 問）
FTD_TITLES.k3: 数字とアルファベットの言い方（10 問）
FTD_TITLES.k4: 交信のチェアフライト

classSectionIds.src: function classSectionIds(FL, i) { const book = gameBook(FL); return (CLASS_CHAPTERS[i] || []).flatMap(id => (book.chapters.find(c => c.id === id) || { sections: [] }).sections.map(s => s.id)); }

heardOf.src: function heardOf(FL, state) { return heardSet(state, CLASS_CHAPTERS.map((_, k) => sectionsBefore(FL, k + 1).slice(sectionsBefore(FL, k).length))); }

lectureGroups.src:
(text, o = {}) => speechLines(inClass(text), { max: LECTURE_LINE, ...o }).map(callFix)
  .map(l => l.replace(/([。！？.!?])([）」』”])。$/, '$1$2')).map(l => fit(l)).filter(g => g.length)

minutesOf.src: (nodes, start, flags) => pathOf(nodes, start, flags).reduce((s, id) => s + readingSeconds(nodes[id].text), 0) / 60

scoreOf.src: (state, n) => { let right = 0; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) if (state.flags[`qz_${k}`]) right++; const pct = n ? Math.round(right / n * 100) : 0; return { right, n, pct, pass: pct >= PASS }; }

sectionsBefore.src: function sectionsBefore(FL, i) { const book = gameBook(FL); return CLASS_CHAPTERS.slice(0, i).flat().flatMap(id => (book.chapters.find(c => c.id === id) || { sections: [] }).sections.map(s => s.id)); }
